insurathon2026.title: True Aim wins the 2026 Insurathon
insurathon2026.excerpt: Norton Rose Fulbright named True Aim the most innovative InsurTech start-up at its ninth Insurathon, pitched in London on 1 July 2026.
insurathon2026.p1: Norton Rose Fulbright named True Aim AG the winner of its 2026 Insurathon, the law firm's ninth annual competition for the most innovative InsurTech start-up. The final was pitched in London on 1 July 2026 and the result was announced on 3 July 2026.
insurathon2026.p2: True Aim builds claims technology for insurers, warranty providers and claims administrators. Language models read the documents of a claim, a deterministic decision engine applies the policy wording, and every decision carries the facts, the rules and the reasoning behind it.
insurathon2026.sourceLabel: Norton Rose Fulbright, news release of 3 July 2026
